verdict.rationale: Convex has no built-in natural-language console. It does ship its own official MCP server, which lets AI agents act on a deployment, and documents agent-driven workflows such as asking a coding agent to create a new Convex app and an agent-setup guide. Natural-language operation therefore depends on an external agent, and the MCP server cannot reach production deployments by default. Missing for 10: native first-party natural-language interface, detailed documentation of which operations the MCP tools cover, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation working in practice.
